content: उत्कर्ष {%a.%} .²1 Superior, eminent. .²2 Much, abundant .²3 Exaggerated, boastful. .²4 Attractive. .{@-र्षः@} .²1 Pulling off or upwards, drawing or pulling up; चरणोत्कर्षैर्दारयन्निव मेदिनीम् <ls>Rām. 3. 56. 29</ls>. .²2 Elevation, eminence, rise, prosperity; निनीषुः कुलमुत्कर्षम् <ls>Ms. 4. 244</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 24</ls>. .²3 Increase, abundance, excess; पञ्चानामपि भूतानामुत्कर्षं पुपुषुर्गुणाः <ls>R. 4. 11</ls>. .²4 Excellence, highest merit, glory; उत्कर्षः स च धन्विनां यदिषवः सिध्यन्ति लक्ष्ये चले <ls>Ś. 2. 5</ls>. .²5 Self-conceit, boasting. .²6 Joy, pleasure. .²7 Postponement (of some detail or details at a विकृतियाग) {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} performing them at a later stage; तदादि उत्कर्षे तदन्तमपकर्षे स्यात् <ls>ŚB. on MS. 5. 1. 24</ls>.
